copyright_note: Reference for art direction only. Do not copy third-party character or weapon assets.

approved_visual_style.rendering: stylized gothic horror 2.5D, crisp graphic ink-shadows, not realistic military shooter, no mixed pixel/3D styles
approved_visual_style.location: gothic church nave, ribbed stone arches, warm candle pools, blue moonlight through stained glass, legible central aisle
approved_visual_style.playable_character: the owner-selected dark nun: black ripped habit sleeves, pale exposed hands, black veil, ivory wimple, rope belt with cross
approved_visual_style.weapon: WWII MP40 correct geometry and aligned iron sights, consistent gun size across hip/ADS/reload
approved_visual_style.arms: same pale bare hands / black habit sleeves across all frames; NO olive tactical gloves or army jackets
approved_visual_style.performance: Pixel Fold: target stable 30 FPS minimum with touch input responsive; establish real telemetry before claimed GREEN
approved_visual_style.screenshots: Never generate or post synthetic art references as proof of game; screenshots must be captured from the running actual build.

acceptance_gates: Match reference art silhouette of MP40 and bare pale nun hands in hip, ADS, reload, sprint and firing
Maintain exact left-hand gun support and right-hand firing grip in every animation
Center iron sights exactly over world reticle in ADS
No mix of pixel-art reload with photorealistic hip-fire
Do not introduce stock nun debug rectangles
Device FPS >= 30 under 10 zombies + full first room for 2 minutes on Pixel Fold
Source Tripo textures and meshes pinned to original hashes
